governance.process: Versioned product/PMS governance and organisational responsibilities
roles: PRRC: documented responsibility, not a third signature
governance.failureRecovery: Reject stale source revision; preserve old governance/evidence and reconcile the same command after unknown commit.
governance.gap: Existing reads and controlled changes do not prove complete PMS-system files or organisational PRRC appointments.

intake.process: Signal intake, awareness, product match and original provenance
intake.failureRecovery: Retain first awareness, source ID and original bytes; local recording cannot acknowledge regional durability; same CommandId reconciles retries.
intake.gap: Canonical intake exists; complete multichannel/file intake and Fabric-protected awareness require separate implementation and execution.

assessment.process: Evidence-bound assessment, independent assurance and human disposition
assessment.failureRecovery: Model/search failure stays explicit; manual route remains available; changed evidence invalidates new-release approvals without deleting old signatures.
assessment.gap: Clinical quality requires curated independent expert cases; structural tests and deterministic replay cannot establish medical validity.

deadlines.process: Awareness-bound legal deadlines, internal safety deadlines and independent escalation
deadlines.failureRecovery: Timers do not wait for IQ/agents; overdue/unknown work escalates; restore preserves original awareness and warning timestamps.
deadlines.gap: Independent outage-domain watchdog, 24/7 human response and measured timing targets need deployed drills, not local self-health.

reports.process: Draft, bound preview, two-person approval and submission reconciliation
reports.failureRecovery: Unknown never authorises blind resend; reconcile original attempt/profile/package IDs; new revisions cannot reuse old approvals.
reports.gap: Generic report flows are partial candidates; each report type, jurisdiction/recipient preview and real channel needs its own evidence.

summary.process: Periodic summary agreement and exact selected case reporting, distinct from PSUR
summary.failureRecovery: Withdrawn/mismatched agreements block new effects; old agreement/case snapshots remain immutable; replay reconciles original report IDs.
summary.gap: No real authority agreement or receipt is inferred from simulated summary reports.

correspondence.process: Original-bound authority/NB correspondence, owner, response and separate deadlines
correspondence.failureRecovery: Late/duplicate replies reconcile only the addressed original round and profile; cannot complete unrelated native obligations.
correspondence.gap: End-to-end recipient directories, distribution and real authority/NB cooperation remain separately gated.

evidence.process: Versioned original/derivative evidence and controlled QMS/PMCF/SSCP/TD changes
evidence.failureRecovery: Missing/corrupt original fails visibly; no LLM replacement; historical access is reauthorised after account/product-scope changes.
evidence.gap: Generic evidence is not complete PMCF/study/SSCP/PLM functionality. D/Z scope requires explicit documents/tasks and external completion evidence.

sources.process: Public-source reading and human relevance, synthetic internal/clinical register input
sources.failureRecovery: Cursor/deduplication persists under same source identity; failed public retrieval stays failure, never a successful replay or own-manufacturer case.
sources.gap: Live source rights and actual transport need explicit evidence; file intake/OCR/quarantine are not established by this public-source adapter.

trends.process: Denominator-aware reproducible trends and human-reviewed signals
trends.failureRecovery: Preserve policy, numerator/denominator and snapshot vector; incomplete exposure prevents rate claims; model failure cannot change deterministic statistics.
trends.gap: Production methods, thresholds, causal interpretation and external denominators need independent methodological approval.

quality.process: Investigation, CAPA, effectiveness and controlled technical-document change
quality.failureRecovery: Stale action/source versions and self-approval fail; incomplete effectiveness evidence cannot silently close CAPA.
quality.gap: Complete external QMS/PLM and actual field corrective action remain outside the synthetic pilot.

specimen.process: Specimen custody, prior authority information and internal human investigation release
specimen.failureRecovery: Preserve condition/custody and notice proof; uncertain notice blocks destructive simulated examination until reconciled.
specimen.gap: No real specimen examination or universal legal authority-approval requirement is introduced.

psur.process: Frozen PSUR period, provenance, independent author/assurance and two human approvals
psur.failureRecovery: Keep frozen revision vector and source bytes; report edits require new approvals; generated text is never an already approved report.
psur.gap: Each PSUR field/table/monthly view and clinical interpretation needs ID-specific acceptance; generic generation is insufficient.

psur-series.process: PSUR leading identity, grouping, gap-free periods and lifecycle
psur-series.failureRecovery: Concurrent period/group change must conflict; retry resolves same command; no leading-ID replacement or deletion on lifecycle expiry.
psur-series.gap: Native locking must be replaced with certified multi-aggregate ordering before Fabric activation; organisational schedule agreement is external.

information.process: Minimal information request, simulated delivery and explicit response mapping
information.failureRecovery: Unknown delivery cannot be blindly retried; missing references hold the response for mapping, and unanswered questions do not stop deadlines.
information.gap: Only simulated clinical communication; actual recipients, disclosure basis and external processing need separate approval.

integration.process: Actor/configuration lifecycle and bound simulator/Domibus transport
integration.failureRecovery: No automatic simulator fallback, rerouting or real resend of synthetic attempts; unknown delivery reconciles fixed message and original profile.
integration.gap: Stub, native Domibus/AS4, playground registration and real authority acceptance are separate gates.

audit.process: Protected original evidence, scoped audit export and independent integrity/recovery
audit.failureRecovery: Missing original/digest/tail/authorization fails closed; only complete certified replay can restore a current head; unknown is not rollback.
audit.gap: Inherited transactional audit is not SQL Ledger, WORM or Fabric proof. G01/G02 block activation until actual service evidence exists.

retention.process: Data-class retention, legal hold and explicit lifecycle/deletion separation
retention.failureRecovery: Deletion/suppression journal must survive recovery and derived-copy rebuild; failure remains explicit and reconciles the original operation.
retention.gap: Locked A/B WORM, long-term readability and approved retention are not demonstrated by local synthetic deletion tests.

identity.process: Least privilege, product scope, separate humans and no agent decision authority
identity.failureRecovery: Reauthorise all reads/downloads and resumed jobs; revoked or stale identities cannot reuse cached scopes or approvals.
identity.gap: Real Entra, Fabric/OneLake/IQ private paths, pseudonymisation and organisational authority need independent negative service tests.

ui.process: Accessible branded workspaces, separated process states and source-grounded visualisation
roles: Authenticated product-scoped human reader; commands retain server-side role checks
ui.failureRecovery: Account/scope change clears stale views; unknown states stay visible; presentation toggles must not mutate signed payloads.
ui.gap: Browser/accessibility acceptance and X-12/X-15 remain explicit work, not inferred from existing screens.

platform.process: Fabric capability, runtime, recovery and independent delivery acceptance
api: GET /health/ready (candidate only; not a capability acceptance endpoint)
G01-G11 capability harness: planned, no public mutation endpoint
platform.failureRecovery: No final ACK with one protection region, stale epoch or incomplete certificate; deadlines/manual route continue; dependent deployment stays blocked.
platform.gap: No Fabric adapter/service/host/region/capacity is accepted. Native and cloud execution require separately allocated, approved resources.
